propositions: Two CloudWatch alarms (voter_errors, replication_errors) declare no alarm_actions or ok_actions, causing alarm transitions OK→ALARM to notify nobody despite being wired to fire.

The omission violates the repo-wide convention: 11 of 13 aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm blocks wire both alarm_actions and ok_actions to the shared aws_sns_topic.alerts.arn, but these two alone omit them.
The voter_errors alarm is a safety net for the LLM-Review gate blocking all main-branch submissions; when the voter fails closed, changes become unsubmittable silently to both Gerrit and operators.
A regression guard test must parse every aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm block in infra/terraform/ and fail on any lacking alarm_actions, with anti-vacuity assertions to prevent vacuous passes.
The fix wires both alarms to the established shared SNS topic following existing pattern; no new operator decision needed, and the topic already carries the operator's confirmed email subscription.
Terraform apply was required to complete the fix; merging HCL alone did not change production configuration, leaving both alarms notifying nobody until apply executed.
